title: EOS PEEK HP3 material data sheet, FMO / 07.08
notes: Two-page EOS data sheet dated 07.08, read from a copy hosted by 3dprinting.com (robots.txt allows /wp-content/uploads/); the current EOS page was not checked, hence level C. Published values used here: laser-sintered part density 1.315 g/cm3 (DIN EN ISO 1183), melting point 372 C (DSC), glass transition 164 C (DSC), HDT 165 C (ISO 75, 1.8 MPa), continuous use temperature 180 C mechanical with impact, 240 C mechanical without impact and 260 C electrical (UL 746B). Used only to show that even the hottest laser-sintered polymer in the repository's sources melts below the 427 C synthetic tip surface temperature. EOS states that the data do not guarantee properties for a particular part.
